quality_boundary: Phase 13 Chiba review is in progress. Current plan identity and structure are reviewed at aggregate depth: 2023-2032 basic plan, 2026-2028 second implementation plan, eight fields, 23 policies, 67 measures, and a duplicate-excluded universe of 189 current projects. Field 1 environment/nature is reviewed at 30/30 unique project identities, field 2 safety/security at 31/31, field 3 health/welfare at 18/18, and field 4 children/education at 34/34, bringing cumulative project-identity coverage to 113/189. Twenty-seven displayed repost occurrences reviewed across these fields are preserved without identity inflation. The other 76 current project identities remain pending. Historical FY2024 progress remains tied to the 2023-2025 first implementation plan and covers 360 projects, including a municipality-reported 252 projects at 80% or more of planned quantity. Budget and settlement states remain separate. No project-quantity value, KGI/KPI value, independent policy-achievement judgment, causal attribution, version linkage, or automatic cross-city comparability is inferred from the identity layer.
